column1: # INV-T-4912. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-720, 738, 2433, 2445, 2446, 316, 834,
# 835, 901 and 319 (read from Keel), plus the contract names pinned by coordinator ruling INV-Q-5189 for the same requirements.
# One row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it (or, for a pinned name the text does not backtick, the
# requirement it implements). Columns: identifier, kind, file, requirement key.
# Not rows: resolveMasterData (the operation resolveMasterDataGap on main, INV-REQ-2433, 2445); CanonicalParty.approvedSchemes and
# INFERRED (a scope-pack source class); NA (an IRAS classification); masterdata-svc, canonical-svc, transport-svc, access-svc,
# 429, Retry-After (HTTP); A3PL, ACMT, AISS, AMCS, ARCS, MES (scenario-pack scheme values, not an enum here); CanonicalParty, CanonicalLine
# (canonical contract, Wave 3); console-bff, rules-svc, tenancy-svc, notification-svc, payload-svc, service-runtime (services);
# SecretStore (the secret store); agent.operator, tax.approver, deployment.operator, tenant.admin (roles); ap-callback (an
# adapter name); counterparty (an actor); FR-E.7 (a source reference).
# INV-T-7894 (INV-REQ-310, 1007, 1270, INV-AC-1602, 7821, 7822): entity.admin (added here), tenant.admin and tax.approver are roles, not rows;
# PendingIdentityTripleChange (a bare schema name) has no row kind in the checker, so it is covered by the scoped rows
# (entity, constitution) is a key pair written in prose, not an identifier of the contract; OTHER_ADMIN, TAX_APPROVER, TENANT (catalogue
# keys and a scope level of catalogue/variation-points/variation-points.yaml), BLOCKED (a document state), acKeyCoverage (a check of INV-T-4942).
# INV-T-8433 (INV-REQ-313, 314, 315, 2446, 2576, INV-AC-8371, 8372, 8374, 8378, 8379): not rows: provided_by, evidence_ref, captured_at
# (storage names of the service data model, carried here as providedBy, evidenceRef, capturedAt); party, party_identifier, entity_identity
# (service tables); HELD, BLOCKED (document states); NONE, NA (free string values, not enum members); masterdata-svc, canonical-svc
# (services); MasterDataResolved (an event); tax.operator (a role); Counterparty (a bare schema name); CanonicalLine, CanonicalLine.arcsGstChargeAgreed
# (canonical contract, Wave 3); ARCS (a scheme value); x-timeout, x-operation.role, x-extensible-enum, masterdata/openapi.yaml, identifier,
# items, ac-keys.tsv, ac_refs, given, MIGRATE (extension names, a path, a generic word or task text, not contract identifiers); the dotted paths
# (Counterparty.address.addressLine1, ResolutionResult.findings[].code, CounterpartyHistory.items[].version, ...) are covered by the property rows
# and the rows ResolutionFinding.code and CounterpartyVersion.version; provenance already has a row (INV-REQ-512).
